notes.note: This is three in the 80s now for Farrow with his 21 disposals at 95% efficiency this week.
It's been a good three week run for Farrow and his owners which is what we needed over the byes. Now is the time to decide that we either upgrade or keep for bench cover.
Farrow beat his BE but not by much from his 22 disposal game. He is just about fully priced now so upgrade before his bye.
Farrow beat his BE but has a new one of 72 meaning he has pretty much topped out in value so he should be on your trade out listing.
This was the best we have seen from Farrow since round 5 and cements a good two week period for him. Those that have held have certainly been rewarded this week as his BE also dropped.
18 disposals for Farrow and his best score since round 5. This was a great result for those who held. His value dropped as he didn't get his BE however the new one is achievable.
17 touches for Farrow who only just missed his BE. He is one that you may want to consider trading as his big scores seem to be behind him.
Farrow had 19 disposals with 7 marks as he continues to generate some great cash for us. He is still someone we need to have.
Farrow couldn't replicate the huge scores of the last two weeks but was very good and has kept his BE low at 4 and does look like he is safe in that side.
Farrow was one of the most traded in players this week and owners would have been very happy with a 102. 12 marks and 22 disposals in the Bomber win. He is one you can still get in.
Farrow played his second game and it was a great one with 21 disposals and 12 marks. He will be the hot downgrade target of the week.

Farrow played his first game and had 12 kicks and 1 handball with 6 marks and he used the footy well with 92% efficiency as the best for the Bombers. The score wasn't huge so let's watch another game.
